How a photo's colours render is checked by the camera and process golden tests (CameraGoldenTests, ProcessStabilityTests), not by working the app
Demosaic quality is checked by the engine's decode and golden tests, not by working the app
Highlight reconstruction is checked by the engine's golden tests, not by working the app
Hot pixels and banding are checked by the engine's decode regression tests, not by working the app
There's no CC0 sample of an unsupported raw (such as Nikon's High Efficiency NEF) in the fixtures; a damaged file stands in for one that won't open
Whether an export matches the editor is the rendering gates' job (ARC-03 and ARC-04: preview against a downscaled export)
Updates are checked on the signed app by the release gate's black box (scripts/test-update.sh --auto), since test builds have no update feed
The command-line tool is checked by the release gate's black box (the bundled CLI renders a photo) and by its own commands' tests
The website isn't part of the app; web/ has its own tests
Needs iCloud Drive or an external or network disk; the conflict merges and coordinated writes are unit-tested (SidecarSafetyTests, OtherWriterTests)
Virtual Copy is planned for Phase 2; the menu checks that its item is there and disabled
